name: Variants
source:
Component(id: "test/variants", name: "Variants", kind: Kind.section, description: "Rules", defaultVariant: isMobile() ? "compact" : "wide")

Options(
  title: String(label: "Title", maxLength: 40, default: "Hello"),
  pick<Product>(required: true),
  tags<Category[]>(),
  onTap: Action(label: "Tapped"),
)

State(
  open: Bool(default: false),
  count: Number(default: 2),
)

Parts(
  heading: Text(child: options.title),
)

Variants(
  compact: Variant(label: "Compact", options: Options(size: Number(label: "Size", min: 1, max: 50, default: 12)), Build(
    Text(child: options.title, size: options.size)
  )),
  wide: Variant(label: "Wide", Build(Column(children: [Use(part: "heading"), Text(child: options.pick.name)]))),
)
